name: tts-human-eval
description: Paid human listeners judge your text-to-speech audio blind: pairwise preference or human-vs-AI detection, with confidence intervals. Adds the Woodstitch MCP tools and a skill that knows when and how to run a listening test. Some tools act on your account: create_eval creates and prices a study (no charge), start_eval spends account credit up to the quote you approved, cancel_eval stops a study, delete_file deletes an uploaded file. No tool sends messages, publishes, or changes access.
